statements.impact_statement: Review 2026-09-30, Chainguard cosign 3.1.3 image binary (index sha256:e7ef547a42e52b877a9069ee49e2caa6287c30bcb97d27df3ec5d22c0afdbb6f). GO-2026-6180 affects golang.org/x/mod/sumdb (Client.Lookup). Cosign v3.1.3 (source 11926fa5bbbbde47e88fc006b625a17769b743b2) does not import that package: govulncheck v1.8.0 (golang.org/x/vuln) reports it only at module level in source mode, and binary mode finds none of its symbols in the image binary. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6180. This statement applies only to the pinned binary and dependency versions named in products.

Review 2026-09-30, Chainguard cosign 3.1.3 image binary (index sha256:e7ef547a42e52b877a9069ee49e2caa6287c30bcb97d27df3ec5d22c0afdbb6f). GO-2026-6179 affects golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog (tileHashReader.ReadHashes). Cosign v3.1.3 (source 11926fa5bbbbde47e88fc006b625a17769b743b2) does not import that package: govulncheck v1.8.0 (golang.org/x/vuln) reports it only at module level in source mode, and binary mode finds none of its symbols in the image binary. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6179. This statement applies only to the pinned binary and dependency versions named in products.

Review 2026-09-30, rclone/rclone:1.75.1 image binary (index sha256:45401ad7410db1d67ffdb58e19059ad20b0d8e0285a60e38bbec55cc1019c7a5). GO-2026-6443 (GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj) panics gRPC servers created with xds.NewGRPCServer; the affected symbols are internal/transport http2Server.HandleStreams/operateHeaders and internal/xds/server RouteAndProcess. rclone v1.75.1 (source 687d264b689b8c49a67e2e52a8a5e0caa01c04ce) never calls xds.NewGRPCServer and starts no gRPC server; the evidence sink runs rclone only as an S3 client. govulncheck v1.8.0 (golang.org/x/vuln) in source mode lists GO-2026-6443 only under imported packages without a call path; the binary links the symbols through the grpc xds package. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6443; https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/security/advisories/GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj. This statement applies only to the pinned binary and dependency versions named in products.

Review 2026-11-12, cgr.dev/chainguard/cosign:latest image binary (index sha256:22aef19926386aef51507db17ad256b62de1c05788eafca69072864914de1845). CVE-2026-78661 (GO-2026-6860) affects golang.org/x/net/html (quadratic text-node coalescing in addText/fosterParent). Cosign v3.1.4 (source 0e48502cf5ef34e2e60bbd3617aa19945712f705) does not import golang.org/x/net/html: go list -deps ./cmd/cosign omits the package, and govulncheck v1.8.0 (golang.org/x/vuln) source mode does not report GO-2026-6860 among called vulnerabilities. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6860. This statement applies only to the pinned binary and dependency versions named in products.

Review 2026-11-12, openpolicyagent/opa:1.22.4-static image binary (index sha256:12cecac5a174368f7d3f09d3a19d040ebe0c91d576e520335ae7a985a26e39d3). CVE-2026-78661 (GO-2026-6860) affects golang.org/x/net/html (quadratic text-node coalescing in addText/fosterParent). OPA v1.22.4 (source ba39415db4b3c90cd68942a74b3cc2223ec2b23c) does not import golang.org/x/net/html: govulncheck v1.8.0 (golang.org/x/vuln) binary mode on the image binary reports no called vulnerable symbols and lists GO-2026-6860 only at module level (golang.org/x/net@v0.60.0, fixed v0.62.0); go list -deps confirms golang.org/x/net/html is absent. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6860. This statement applies only to the pinned binary and dependency versions named in products.
